product_one_liner.value: Authenticate provides identity verification and background checks through APIs, SDKs and hosted workflows for businesses that need to verify users, prevent fraud and meet compliance requirements.

pricing_page.notes: Public per-check pricing is published in the homepage pricing section.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 13 employees; the independent company directory explicitly gives the 11–20 band.

hq_location.notes: Listed headquarters; the website separately gives a Park City, Utah contact address.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog contains marketing, buyer education, compliance and product/integration posts, not two engineer-authored accounts of how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation includes multiple guides and API reference sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers feed returns an empty jobs array.

model_provider.notes: No named AI model or model provider was disclosed in the public product documentation, AI/product explanations, compliance FAQ or privacy policy; no named-AI-vendor subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the company’s public compliance claims, including SOC 2 Type 2; this does not independently validate certification or attestations.

last_funding.notes: The latest funding round cannot be established reliably: the investor’s 2022 annual report lists a follow-on investment in Authenticate.com without a company-specific month, amount or round designation; PitchBook lists an undated private secondary transaction and a 2016 angel deal, while Tracxn labels the company unfunded. Sources: https://tcaventuregroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/TCA-Annual-Report-2022-final.pdf ; https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/472511-08 ; https://tracxn.com/d/companies/authenticate/__nLkX70v1Md2Oox91onhqKGJk65gEvBCHQHdzp1cCnHw .

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent dated investment evidence located is TCA’s follow-on investment in 2022, before 2025-05-09; no later capital-raise announcement was found. An undated secondary transaction is not evidence of fresh capital raised.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers feed returns an empty jobs array.

launched_6mo.notes: Published 2026-07-14: announces the new Hostfully integration, automating guest screening, identity verification and background checks inside Hostfully.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small public org chart lists CEO Steve Ward and CTO Anshaj Goel. Their profiles show starts in April 2018 and September 2020 respectively; no departure announcement was located in the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy names these as business-customer data providers used to supplement submitted information; it does not establish either as the internal CRM of record.
